originality.rationale: The new claim is the exact all-n PSD elliptope volume of edge-glued triangles and its exponential ratio, not the already published cut-volume formula or Laurent cosine-parameterization. The closest primary 2026 work states an exact triangle and cycle elliptope law, a one-vertex-gluing product theorem, and an existing star-suspension cut volume, but no edge-glued PSD volume. Lee 2026 computes cut/Boolean volumes through series-parallel dynamic programming, not an elliptope formula. Related published findings concern different book-graph convex bodies or a K_{2,n} graph with the central edge absent. The general cosine parameterization does not supply the numerical book-volume result without an extra all-n integral evaluation.

value.rationale: The book graphs are the smallest natural series-parallel family whose triangle pages overlap in a full edge rather than a single vertex. An exact all-order PSD-volume invariant is mathematically motivated by the global looseness of semidefinite cut relaxations; the theorem supplies the value for every n and a sharp exponential constant and first correction. Comparing n-page edge-glued books with vertex-glued triangle products shows an inherently structural dependence on the mode of clique gluing, not a numerical increment, and answers a natural extension of existing exact cycle-volume literature.
